```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    size='weight_grams',
    alpha=0.6,
    data=df
)
plt.xscale('log')
plt.yscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels (log scale)')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD, log scale)')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (Size = Weight)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
